title: Halloween Baby Goat Yoga
long_description:
Trick or Treat Yourself to Goat Yoga!

About this Event

🎃 Halloween Goat Yoga at The Community Farm 🐐🧘‍♀️
Yoga starts at 3:00 PM— Costumes encouraged!
Celebrate spooky season with a yoga class like no other — surrounded by playful goats in costume! Come dressed up, stretch it out, snuggle some goats, and snap a few fun photos. This class is open to all ages, levels, and abilities — no experience needed!
What to Expect:✨ Yoga begins at 3:00 PM ✨ Goat cuddles & photo time included✨ A relaxed, fun, and welcoming environment
What to Bring & Know:
Bring your own mat (a limited number are available to rent).Dress for the weather — wear layers and sunscreen.Parking is limited — carpooling is encouraged!🕸️ In Case of Weather or Rescheduling:If we need to reschedule due to weather or capacity, your ticket will be transferred to another upcoming session. If you can't make the new date, you'll have 30 days to rebook for another event.
Please note: refunds are not available for missed sessions.

Also check out other in Arvada, Health & Wellness events in Arvada, Workshops in Arvada.
